title: U.S. House · Ohio's 3rd District
area: Central Ohio, including most of Columbus

context.text: The Cook Political Report rates the 3rd District D+21, a safely Democratic-leaning seat.

summary.text: Beatty is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Ohio's 3rd District, first elected in 2012. She previously served in the Ohio House of Representatives and as senior vice president of outreach and engagement at Ohio State University.

background.text: Born in Montgomery County, Ohio; graduated from Nettie Lee Roth High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Central State University and a master's degree from Wright State University.
Worked as a college professor and in human services before serving in the Ohio State House and as senior vice president of outreach and engagement at Ohio State University.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Financial Services in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

Served on the Committee on Financial Services in the 118th Congress (2023-2024), including as ranking member of the Subcommittee on National Security, Illicit Finance, and International Financial Institutions.

summary.text: Dulaney is a small-business owner running as the Republican nominee. His campaign website lists housing affordability, policing, homelessness and addiction, and property taxes as issues.

background.text: Grew up in Birmingham, Alabama; professional experience includes owning his own business.

priorities.text: Campaign website lists gentrification and the affordable-housing crisis in the district as issues, citing regional projections of population growth.
Campaign website calls for a 'better relationship with our police force' and addressing homelessness and opioid-addiction rehabilitation.
Campaign website lists property taxes and home-improvement grants as an issue.
